node_types.name: Engine
node_types.definition: An internal control-plane engine implementing one decision concern within pool_membership_manager: pure decision logic that proposes pool_registry transitions through a CAS-gated commit path.

node_types.name: CommitGate
node_types.definition: An internal sequencer that owns the per-(chain, fork_id) pool_registry shard CAS line: serializes all admit/evict/quarantine/drain-fence/rebalance proposals from the engines, enforces priority lanes, and exposes the atomic re-check primitive used by override commits.

node_types.name: EvidenceStore
node_types.definition: A durable store internal to pool_membership_manager that holds evidence the engines and the commit gate need: phase-marker records, override audit trail, roster cache with HLC-bounded freshness witness.

node_types.name: BroadcastConsumer
node_types.definition: An internal consumer subservice that receives a signed broadcast from outside chain_router (lifecycle_gate drain-fence, region_coordinator roster), verifies it as a self-contained credential bundle, and hands the verified payload to engines/commit gate.

node_types.name: DispatchGuard
node_types.definition: An internal guard subservice that inspects every dispatched RPC before it leaves pool_membership_manager: cost-class hint presence, replica-class match, fork_id re-validation; refuses or rebounds on mismatch.

nodes.definition: Owns admit/evict lifecycle decisions for replicas in (chain, fork_id) sub-pools: proposes admitted/draining/evicted/quarantined transitions through the commit sequencer; gates admit on drain-completed-or-aborted and evict on drain-completed by reading the replica's drain_state_log entry; refuses re-admission of a draining replica unless an explicit drain-abort transition has been committed first; refuses any quarantine eviction whose commit would push the (chain, fork_id) sub-pool's healthy-replica count below the documented safe-membership floor and surfaces an alert with the (chain, fork_id) at risk; refuses admit of a tip-class request to an archive-only replica and vice versa, consulting the replica-health register for replica-class.

Owns the operator-override admission path used during emergency rollover when normal blue/green admit cannot keep up with replica loss: enforces M-of-N operator quorum signatures on the admit proposal; rejects proposals whose signing roster_version predates the currently-effective roster_version; verifies override at commit time against region_coordinator's currently-active roster_version (named-roster lookup, not local cache) including evaluation of any retroactive-as-of-HLC compromise-revocation predating the proposal's submission HLC; proposes the admit through the commit sequencer atomically re-checked with the pool_registry CAS commit; enforces a documented max-overrides-per-window rate limit on overrides that bypass the safe-membership floor; falls to deny-by-default for further override admissions when the cached roster is older than the documented HLC-bounded freshness window or no roster has ever been received, deny is sticky until a strictly-newer roster_version ack-readies; records the signing operators with the admit commit.

Owns the quarantine eviction proposal path: consumes parent-scope quarantine_set divergence evidence (read from outside this scope) and proposes per-replica eviction-to-quarantined transitions through the commit sequencer; refuses any commit that would push the (chain, fork_id) sub-pool below the safe-membership floor; respects schema_skew_quarantine's per-(chain, fork_id) max-concurrent-quarantine-commits cap and surfaces deferred-quarantine state into the replica-health register so the effective-capacity calculator excludes deferred-quarantine replicas from the denominator.

Owns per-(chain, fork_id) sub-pool composition: maintains the documented target-capacity surface; when traffic share for a sub-pool exceeds its target by a documented margin, proposes membership rebalances (admit additional replicas of that fork; drain over-provisioned rare-fork replicas) gated on the safe-membership floor for both source and destination sub-pools; commits new sub-pool membership in pool_registry through the commit sequencer when fork_detection_alerter signals a sub-pool repartition for (chain, fork_id) before the routing-table fence admits the new fork (prerequisite for the chain_router-level fork-transition handshake to fanout); refuses to commit cross-fork moves that would violate replica-class constraints.

Computes the effective-capacity denominator (count of replicas currently admitted AND not draining AND not in deferred-quarantine AND not tip-stale) for each (chain, fork_id) by reading per-shard summaries from the replica-health register; recomputes on every relevant lifecycle transition committed through the commit sequencer; propagates the denominator to sub_pool_fork_partitioner outside this scope so per-replica fan-out reflects the actually-serving subset rather than total pool_registry membership.

Owns the per-(chain, fork_id) pool_registry shard CAS line for all admit/evict/quarantine/drain-fence/rebalance proposals from the engines: serializes proposals in shard order; enforces the drain-fence-priority lane where drain-fence flush transitions pre-empt deferred-quarantine commits and deferred-quarantine commits wait until drain-fence ACK-EMITTED; provides the atomic re-check primitive used by override_admission_engine so the activation race cannot slip between roster check and registry commit; fences against fork-transition handshake state so it refuses to commit a drain-ack while a fork-transition handshake is mid-flight on any (chain, fork_id) shard whose audit writes for tenant T are in flight (extending the drain-fence ack-window HLC budget across handshake completion or rejecting the broadcast with a typed drain-fence-blocked-by-fork-transition attestation); records every commit's signing operator identities (when override) and shard hlc_stamp.

Per-(chain, fork_id, replica_id) health register internal to pool_membership_manager: caches each replica's current lifecycle flags (admitted, draining, deferred-quarantine, tip-stale) read from per-shard pool_registry summaries; records replica-class (tip-serving / historical-archive / both); refreshes from each commit sequencer transition; serves as the freshness-witness denominator source for the effective-capacity calculator and the replica-class authority for the dispatch validator; per-replica entries carry the hlc_stamp at which they were last refreshed.

Durable journal of typed per-(offboarding_id, component_id, drain_id) phase-markers (RECEIVED, FLUSH-IN-PROGRESS, FLUSH-COMPLETE, ACK-EMITTED, ATTESTATION-WRITTEN, TERMINAL-ACK, TERMINAL-PRESERVATION-BLOCKED) maintained on every drain-fence broadcast accepted by this scope; on restart the engines resume from the last durable phase and never re-run a non-idempotent phase, never retract a drain-ack; carries the canonical-writer-election CAS evidence shared with drain_coordinator's drain_state_log so attestation to compliance_audit is written exactly once per terminal class; records the operator-credential roster_version active at each override commit and the M-of-N signing operator identities for audit.

Local cache of operator-credential rosters indexed by roster_version: every entry carries the freshness-witness hlc_stamp at which the roster was last received; the cache acts only as the freshness witness, never as the authority for verifying signed broadcasts (those verifications fetch the named roster_version from region_coordinator on cache miss). Falls outside the documented HLC-bounded freshness window when no broadcast has refreshed it, in which case the override_admission_engine reads it as deny-by-default sticky-until-newer-roster-acks.

Consumes lifecycle_gate-originated drain-fence broadcasts for tenant T: treats every broadcast as a self-contained credential bundle naming roster_version V_named; on cache miss (V_named strictly newer than roster_cache) synchronously fetches V_named from region_coordinator over the cert-bearing inter-region surface bounded by an HLC budget tighter than the per-tenant ack window; coalesces fetches across a bulk-offboarding wave so N broadcasts trigger one fetch; on fetch failure rejects with a typed named-roster-unfetchable (single-broadcast) or named-roster-fetch-failed-bulk (wave) attestation to compliance_audit; on verified broadcast hands the payload to admit_evict_engine to flush in-flight audit writes for T to compliance_audit and propose drain-ack via the commit sequencer's drain-fence-priority lane within the HLC-bounded ack window; writes and reads phase-markers in the phase-marker journal for restart safety.

Consumes region_coordinator-originated roster updates and on-demand named-roster fetch responses; verifies the signed roster bundle under lifecycle-gate authority; refreshes roster_cache with the new roster_version and the freshness-witness hlc_stamp; on receiving a compromise-revocation update propagates a retroactive-as-of-HLC invalidation that the override_admission_engine consults at commit time so commits fail closed if any signing credential is retroactively revoked; the consumer is read-only with respect to the 2PC rotation flow at region_coordinator and never bypasses it.

Inspects every dispatched RPC at the moment of dispatch from pool_membership_manager to a replica: re-validates the replica's currently-recorded fork_id in the replica-health register against the request's (chain, fork_id) tag (mismatch returns retryable-on-other-replica); refuses any dispatch lacking a cost-class hint when the request type requires one (long-RPC archive paths) and surfaces an alert if a cost-class-less retry arrives; verifies the replica-class includes the request's class (tip-serving vs archive); never dispatches forward-progress on a new fork_id whose commit sequencer shard has not yet recorded the fanout-handshake-ack.

requirements.description: Admit/evict transitions are gated on the replica's drain_state_log entry: admit requires drain-completed-or-aborted, evict requires drain-completed; concurrent proposals are CAS-ordered through the per-(chain, fork_id) shard line so admit-during-drain or evict-after-readmit cannot both commit. Re-admission of a draining replica requires an explicit drain-abort transition before admit can commit.

Quarantine eviction proposals refuse to commit if the commit would push the (chain, fork_id) sub-pool's healthy-replica count below the documented safe-membership floor; refusal surfaces an alert with the (chain, fork_id) at risk and the candidate replica.

The effective-capacity denominator (admitted AND not draining AND not in deferred-quarantine AND not tip-stale) is computed from per-shard summaries on every relevant transition and propagated to sub_pool_fork_partitioner outside this scope so per-replica fan-out reflects the actually-serving subset rather than total pool_registry membership.

Admit refuses tip-class request to an archive-only replica and vice versa; dispatch refuses to send a tip-class request to an archive-only replica and vice versa, consulting per-replica replica-class records.
Refuses any dispatch lacking a cost-class hint when the request type requires one (long-RPC archive paths) and surfaces an alert if a cost-class-less retry arrives at dispatch.

On dispatch the dispatch validator re-validates the replica's currently-recorded fork_id against the request's (chain, fork_id) tag at the moment of dispatch (not just at routing-table read time); a mismatch returns a retryable-on-other-replica signal.

Maintains per-(chain, fork_id) target-capacity surface; when traffic share exceeds target by a documented margin, proposes membership rebalances gated on safe-membership floor for both source and destination sub-pools, committed via the same CAS path. On fork_detection_alerter signal, commits new sub-pool membership before chain_router admits the fork-transition handshake to fanout.

Operator-override admission requires M-of-N operator quorum signatures on the admit proposal; signing operators are recorded with the admit commit and visible in audit. The credential model and key custody are parent scope's responsibility.

Override-commit verifies the proposal against region_coordinator's currently-active roster_version (named-roster lookup, not local cache) at commit time, including evaluation of any retroactive-as-of-HLC compromise-revocation predating the proposal's submission HLC; commit fails closed if any signing credential is retroactively revoked. Pre-commit roster_version is re-checked atomically with the pool_registry CAS commit.

Enforces a documented max-overrides-per-window rate limit on operator-override admissions that bypass the safe-membership floor; approaching the limit surfaces an alert; exceeding it rejects further override admits with a documented error code.

Override path falls to deny-by-default when the cached roster is older than the documented HLC-bounded freshness window or when no roster has ever been received; deny is sticky for that override path until a strictly-newer roster_version ack-readies.

Rejects override proposals whose signing roster_version predates the currently-effective roster_version; refuses to commit overrides after a compromise-revocation invalidates any in-flight signature including retroactive-as-of-HLC compromise-revocations; cancel-and-rollback for in-flight proposals is performed atomically at activation by roster_version.

Drain-fence broadcasts for tenant T are consumed as self-contained credential bundles, signature verified against the broadcast's NAMED roster_version (via on-demand named-roster fetch from region_coordinator when V_named is strictly newer than the cache, bounded by an HLC budget tighter than the per-tenant ack window; bulk waves coalesce); on fetch failure rejects with named-roster-unfetchable / named-roster-fetch-failed-bulk attestation. On verified broadcast: flushes in-flight audit writes for T to compliance_audit and acks drain to tenant_store within the HLC-bounded ack window.

Drain-fence flush is admitted on a separate priority lane than quarantine commits on the per-(chain, fork_id) shard CAS line: drain-fence transitions are tagged drain-fence-priority and pre-empt deferred-quarantine commits; deferred-quarantines wait until drain-fence ACK-EMITTED. Surfaces an alert when quarantine deferral grows under drain-fence pressure.

Drain-fence flush is fenced against fork-transition handshake state: refuses to commit a drain-ack while a fork-transition handshake is mid-flight on any (chain, fork_id) shard whose audit writes for tenant T are in flight; ack-window HLC budget extends across handshake completion or the broadcast is rejected with a typed drain-fence-blocked-by-fork-transition attestation. Flush enumerates audit writes by tenant_id across both pre- and post-transition sub-pool views.

Maintains durable per-(offboarding_id, component_id, drain_id) phase-markers (RECEIVED, FLUSH-IN-PROGRESS, FLUSH-COMPLETE, ACK-EMITTED, ATTESTATION-WRITTEN, TERMINAL-ACK, TERMINAL-PRESERVATION-BLOCKED); on restart resumes from the last durable phase, never re-runs a non-idempotent phase, never retracts a drain-ack.

Each terminal class (TERMINAL-ACK / TERMINAL-PRESERVATION-BLOCKED) writes exactly one typed attestation to compliance_audit under the (offboarding_id, component_id, attempt_id) idempotency key; canonical writer election by drain_state_log CAS shared with drain_coordinator outside this scope so the attestation is written exactly once.

On fork_detection_alerter signal of sub-pool repartition for (chain, fork_id), the new sub-pool's membership must be committed in pool_registry through the commit sequencer BEFORE chain_router-level routing-table fence admits the new fork and BEFORE chain_router-level fork-transition handshake to fanout; dispatch validator never dispatches forward-progress on a new fork_id whose commit sequencer shard has not yet recorded the fanout-handshake-ack.

Replica-health register entries are refreshed from each commit sequencer transition and carry the hlc_stamp at which they were last refreshed; effective-capacity calculator and dispatch validator consume per-(chain, fork_id) summaries from the register rather than scanning pool_registry directly.

satisfactions.explanation: admit_evict_engine consults replica_health_register for the replica's drain state and proposes the transition through commit_sequencer; commit_sequencer serializes proposals on the per-(chain, fork_id) shard CAS line; admit_evict_engine refuses re-admit of a draining replica unless an explicit drain-abort transition has been committed first.

quarantine_eviction_engine refuses any commit that would push the (chain, fork_id) sub-pool below the safe-membership floor by reading replica_health_register summaries before proposing; admit_evict_engine mirrors the floor check on its own evictions; refusal surfaces an alert with the (chain, fork_id) at risk.

effective_capacity_calculator reads per-shard summaries from replica_health_register and recomputes the denominator on every commit_sequencer transition; the calculator propagates the denominator to sub_pool_fork_partitioner outside this scope.

replica_health_register records replica-class per replica; admit_evict_engine refuses tip-class admit on archive-only replica and vice versa; dispatch_validator consults the register and refuses dispatches whose replica-class does not include the request's class.
dispatch_validator inspects every dispatch and refuses any lacking a cost-class hint when the request type requires one; surfaces an alert if a cost-class-less retry arrives at dispatch.

dispatch_validator re-validates the replica's currently-recorded fork_id from replica_health_register against the request's (chain, fork_id) tag at the moment of dispatch; mismatch returns retryable-on-other-replica.

sub_pool_composition_engine maintains the target-capacity surface; consults replica_health_register and proposes rebalances through commit_sequencer gated on the floor for source and destination; on fork_detection_alerter signal commits new sub-pool membership through the commit sequencer.
override_admission_engine requires M-of-N operator quorum signatures on every override admit proposal; phase_marker_journal records the signing operator identities at commit.

override_admission_engine drives roster_broadcast_consumer's named-roster lookup at commit time and consults the named roster (not roster_cache) for retroactive-as-of-HLC compromise-revocation; commit_sequencer atomically re-checks roster_version with the pool_registry CAS commit so the activation race cannot slip in.
override_admission_engine tracks an internal max-overrides-per-window counter and rejects further override admits beyond the limit with a documented error code; alert at approach.
override_admission_engine reads roster_cache's freshness-witness hlc_stamp; when the cache is older than the documented window or empty, it falls to deny-by-default sticky-until-newer-roster-acks.

override_admission_engine rejects proposals whose signing roster_version predates the currently-effective roster_version; roster_broadcast_consumer propagates retroactive-as-of-HLC compromise-revocation that the engine consults at commit time so commits fail closed if any signing credential is retroactively revoked; cancel-and-rollback for in-flight proposals is performed atomically at activation by roster_version.

drain_fence_consumer treats every drain-fence broadcast as a self-contained credential bundle, fetches V_named on cache miss bounded by HLC budget tighter than the per-tenant ack window, coalesces fetches across bulk waves, emits typed attestations on fetch failure; on verified broadcast feeds admit_evict_engine which flushes in-flight audit writes for T to compliance_audit and proposes drain-ack via the commit sequencer's drain-fence-priority lane within the HLC-bounded ack window.

commit_sequencer enforces the drain-fence-priority lane on the per-(chain, fork_id) shard CAS line: drain-fence transitions pre-empt deferred-quarantine commits; quarantine_eviction_engine surfaces an alert when its deferred-quarantine queue grows under drain-fence pressure.

commit_sequencer refuses to commit a drain-ack while a fork-transition handshake is mid-flight on any (chain, fork_id) shard with audit writes for T in flight; drain_fence_consumer extends the ack-window HLC budget across handshake completion or rejects with a typed drain-fence-blocked-by-fork-transition attestation; flush enumerates audit writes by tenant_id across both pre- and post-transition sub-pool views.

phase_marker_journal persists durable typed phase-markers; drain_fence_consumer writes RECEIVED on broadcast accept and reads on restart; admit_evict_engine writes FLUSH-IN-PROGRESS / FLUSH-COMPLETE / ACK-EMITTED / ATTESTATION-WRITTEN / TERMINAL-* through commit_sequencer; restart resumes from the last durable phase and never re-runs a non-idempotent phase or retracts a drain-ack.

phase_marker_journal carries the canonical-writer-election CAS evidence shared with drain_coordinator's drain_state_log; admit_evict_engine writes exactly one typed attestation per terminal class to compliance_audit under the (offboarding_id, component_id, attempt_id) idempotency key.

sub_pool_composition_engine commits the new sub-pool's membership through commit_sequencer before any chain_router-level routing-table fence; dispatch_validator consults commit_sequencer's per-(chain, fork_id) shard state and refuses forward-progress dispatch on the new fork_id until the fanout-handshake-ack is recorded.

commit_sequencer writes refreshed entries to replica_health_register on every transition; effective_capacity_calculator and dispatch_validator both consume per-(chain, fork_id) summaries from the register; entries carry the hlc_stamp at which they were last refreshed.
